description: Source code implementing cryptographic functions using mbedtls, including cipher selection, context creation, encryption/decryption, and utility functions.

methods.name: hexstr2buf
methods.description: Converts a hex string to a buffer of bytes, returning the buffer and its length.

methods.name: get_default_cipher
methods.description: Returns the default cipher info, specifically AES-128-CBC.

methods.name: get_cipher_or_print_error
methods.description: Retrieves cipher info by name, printing supported ciphers if invalid.

methods.name: get_cipher_ivsize
methods.description: Returns the IV size of a cipher.

methods.name: get_cipher_keysize
methods.description: Returns the key size in bytes of a cipher.

methods.name: create_ctx
methods.description: Creates and initializes a cipher context for encryption/decryption with specified parameters.

methods.name: do_crypt
methods.description: Performs encryption or decryption on data read from an input file and writes to an output file.

methods.name: free_ctx
methods.description: Frees and cleans up a cipher context.
